name: Hanwha Investment & Securities Co., Ltd.
summary: Hanwha Investment & Securities Co., Ltd. is a South Korean financial firm that primarily focuses on the trading and underwriting of various securities. Beyond its core brokerage services, the company also engages in real estate, general financial investments, investment trust management, and software development. By December 31, 2020, it operated through a network of 46 branches. The firm was established in 1962 and maintains its headquarters in Seoul, South Korea.
